title: Microstructure and mechanical properties at elevated temperatures of a new Al-containing refractory high-entropy alloy Nb-Mo-Cr-Ti-Al
process_description: prepared by arc melting elemental bulk materials (Nb 99.9%, Mo 99.96%, Al 99.9%, Cr 99%, Ti 99.8%) in equiatomic concentration under Ar base pressure of 0.6 bar, with flipping and remelting at least five times for homogenization, then cast into a rod-shaped Cu mold (12mm diameter × 60mm length). Homogenization heat treatment performed at 1300°C for 20h under Ar flow with heating/cooling rate of 4.2 K/min.
